config.label: Gatewards agent API key (gw_agent_…)
config.description: Gatewards agent API key (gw_agent_…). Required for authenticated proxy calls; the server starts without it but cannot reach the gateway.

config.label: Gateway base URL
config.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:3001; set to https://api.gatewards.com for the hosted gateway.
